b2-venezuelasabana-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is a Llanero
b2-venezuelasabana-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about the Llanos of Venezuela, and he asks what a llanero is.
b2-venezuelasabana-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what a llanero is.
cues: Say that he is a man
Say what he does with the cattle
b2-venezuelasabana-01.target: El llanero es el hombre que cuida el ganado a caballo.
b2-venezuelasabana-01.english: The llanero is the man who looks after the cattle on horseback.
b2-venezuelasabana-01.canDo: I can describe a person, a thing or a place with *que*, *quien* and *donde*.

b2-venezuelasabana-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Saw the Waterfall First
b2-venezuelasabana-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You have read an article about Angel Falls, and Meg asks where its current name comes from.
b2-venezuelasabana-02.prompt: Tell Meg who flew over the waterfall in 1933, stressing the person.
cues: Say what he did and when
b2-venezuelasabana-02.target: Fue el piloto Jimmie Angel quien sobrevoló la cascada en 1933.
b2-venezuelasabana-02.english: It was the pilot Jimmie Angel who flew over the waterfall in 1933.
b2-venezuelasabana-02.canDo: I can spotlight a person, a place or a time with *Fue ... quien / donde / cuando* and *Lo que ... es*.

b2-venezuelasabana-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Income Fell
b2-venezuelasabana-03.scenario: You are Meg. You are telling Carlos what you read about the Venezuelan economy.
b2-venezuelasabana-03.prompt: Tell Carlos why the income of the country fell, using a formal connector.
cues: Give the cause with a formal connector
b2-venezuelasabana-03.target: Debido a la caída del precio del petróleo en 2014, los ingresos del país bajaron.
b2-venezuelasabana-03.english: Because of the fall in the oil price in 2014, the country's income fell.
b2-venezuelasabana-03.canDo: I can give a cause with *debido a* or *a raíz de* followed by a noun.

b2-venezuelasabana-04.title: Communicative Challenge: How Many Are Abroad
b2-venezuelasabana-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You are reading a report about Venezuelan migration, and Meg asks how many Venezuelans live abroad.
b2-venezuelasabana-04.prompt: Tell Meg the figure, with its source and its date.
cues: Say the figure and the date
b2-venezuelasabana-04.target: Según ACNUR, a finales de 2025 había unos 7,9 millones de venezolanos fuera del país.
b2-venezuelasabana-04.english: According to UNHCR, at the end of 2025 there were about 7.9 million Venezuelans outside the country.
b2-venezuelasabana-04.canDo: I can give the source of a statement with *según* and report it with *informó de que* or *explica que*.

b2-venezuelasabana-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What Some Migrants Wish
b2-venezuelasabana-05.scenario: You are Meg. You are telling Carlos what you read about the feelings of some Venezuelan migrants.
b2-venezuelasabana-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what some migrants say about staying in their country.
cues: Use a wish about the past
b2-venezuelasabana-05.target: Algunos migrantes dicen que ojalá hubieran podido quedarse en su país.
b2-venezuelasabana-05.english: Some migrants say that they wish they had been able to stay in their country.
b2-venezuelasabana-05.canDo: I can express a wish about the past with *ojalá* + *hubiera* and a participle.

b2-venezuelasabana-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Short Summary
b2-venezuelasabana-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You are telling Carlos what you remember about the music of the Llanos.
b2-venezuelasabana-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what the joropo is.
b2-venezuelasabana-consolidation.target: El joropo es la música que se baila en los Llanos.
b2-venezuelasabana-consolidation.english: The joropo is the music that is danced in the Llanos.
b2-venezuelasabana-consolidation.canDo: I can describe a person, a thing or a place with *que*, *quien* and *donde*.
